subject.title: Telegram should default to allowlist mode with owner ID

question: Should Telegram establish the first owner with a verified challenge during onboarding, or keep pairing for bootstrap and auto-flip the channel policy only after approval?
rationale: The alternatives have different first-run UX, authorization timing, multi-account mapping, and compatibility behavior, so implementation should not choose between them implicitly.

options.title: Verified onboarding allowlist
options.body: Display a one-time token, capture only the matching sender ID, and write an explicit Telegram allowlist during fresh setup.

options.title: Post-approval auto-flip
options.body: Keep pairing for first-owner bootstrap, then safely derive an explicit channel allowlist as proposed in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81876.

options.title: Keep pairing default
options.body: Retain the current trust flow and limit changes to warnings and documentation.

recommendation.title: Verified onboarding allowlist
recommendation.body: Display a one-time token, capture only the matching sender ID, and write an explicit Telegram allowlist during fresh setup.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest cross-surface history and already participated in this issue's product-level review.
